data.name: Violette
data.long_meaning: The name Violette is derived from the Old French word violet, which means 'violet flower'. In Christian symbolism, violets are associated with the Passion of Christ and His Mother Mary. The name Violette is often given to girls born in springtime or to those who are thought to have a gentle, sweet nature.
